desc: The UTG Pro Quick-detachable AK Side Mount fits most AK and Variants with side dovetail rail. Ergonomic lever with quick lock/release with full adjustability, U-cut on top for see-thru application with iron sights. Top rail with 16 slots for flexible optics applications and side rail with detachable 6-slot picatinny rail. Great zero holding and re-zoning capability. Made in the USA.
